summary: This is a clipped Kotlin standard library documentation page for the ObservableProperty class in the kotlin.properties package, covering its members getValue, beforeChange, toString, the constructor, setValue, and afterChange. It describes the class as the core logic of a read/write property delegate that calls callbacks when the value changes. The page notes the APIs are available since version 1.0 on Common, JVM, JS and Native platforms, and that the page is for Kotlin v1.9.23. Navigation, footer and license boilerplate were ignored.
one_line: Kotlin stdlib reference for kotlin.properties.ObservableProperty, a read/write property delegate that invokes change callbacks.
key_facts: ObservableProperty is a class in the kotlin-stdlib package kotlin.properties.
The ObservableProperty constructor takes one parameter, initialValue, the initial value of the property.
The constructor is described as implementing the core logic of a property delegate for a read/write property that calls callback functions when changed.
getValue is declared as open fun getValue(thisRef: Any?, property: KProperty<*>): V and returns the property value for the given object.
setValue is declared as open fun setValue(thisRef: Any?, property: KProperty<*>, value: V) and sets the value of the property for the given object.
beforeChange is a protected open function taking property, oldValue and newValue and returning Boolean.
beforeChange is called before a change to the property value is attempted, when the value has not yet changed.
If beforeChange returns true the property is set to the new value; if it returns false the new value is discarded and the property keeps its old value.
afterChange is a protected open function taking property, oldValue and newValue, with no return value.
afterChange is called after the change of the property is made, when the value has already been changed.
toString is declared as open fun toString(): String and returns a string representation of the object.
The ObservableProperty members are listed as available since version 1.0 on Common, JVM, JS and Native.
The documentation page is for Kotlin version v1.9.23.
